approved_translation: True friendship and cooperation can overcome any danger; friends who work together survive.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a Deer lived in a forest near a lake. Not far from the same lake, a Woodpecker had a nest in the top of a tree; and in the lake lived a Turtle. He found his torn bag, and picking that up he went back to his home. The three friends lived together all the rest of their lives.
